Learn more How to Choose a Criminal Defense Attorney - Criminal Law - Tully Rinckey PLLC Legal Insights - Presented by Bob Babcock, Esq. Facing criminal charges? Choosing the right criminal defense attorney can make a major difference in the outcome of your case. In this video, Bob Babcock, Esq., of Tully Rinckey PLLC’s Criminal Practice Group, shares practical advice on what to look for—and what to avoid—when selecting a defense attorney. 🔹 Why you should choose an attorney who focuses specifically on criminal defense 🔹 The downside of hiring a general practitioner or “family lawyer” 🔹 How word of mouth and referrals are more reliable than ads 🔹 The unique advantage of hiring a former prosecutor 🔹 Why local knowledge of courts and judges matters 🔹 When it might be worth bringing in high-profile legal help 📌 A strong legal defense starts with a smart hiring decision. This video helps you know what questions to ask and what qualifications to prioritize.
